decisions.statement: RLS policies enforce authoritative organization-level tenant isolation in PostgreSQL.
Super Admin access allows reading all platform organizations but restricts all mutations to the explicitly active tenant context.
Atomic purge of React Query cache and local memory queues on tenant switch or logout to prevent cross-tenant data leakage.

actions: Created access-design.md with RBAC matrix, database RLS policies, cache eviction workflow and security test cases.

evidence.description: Access design specification for Platform Auth & Tenant Context
